To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have crystallized and determined the crystal structure of a dengue virus protease complexed to a mung bean protease inhibitor.
we have crystallized and determined the structure of a complex between the dengue virus serine protease and a serine protease inhibitor from mung-bean seeds.
the structure of dengue protease complexed to a Bowman-Birk inhibitor from mung bean has been crystallized and preliminary data have been collected.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and synthesis of inhibitors of dengue NS3 serine-protease, the enzyme responsible for processing the viral polyprotein.
the development of inhibitors of dengue viral NS3 serine proteinase, which is a potential target for antiviral chemotherapy.
the development of inhibitors of the dengue virus serine protease, which is an essential enzyme in the replication of the virus.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this study is the first of its kind in the field of dengue research.

the structure determination of the complex of the dengue virus protease with a Bowman-BirK-type inhibitor from munge-beans has been achieved by the use of MAD methods and that the structure determination will provide a structural framework for the design and development of inhibitors of this important target for chemotherapy of denege infections.
this is the first report of the crystallization of the NS3 serine-protease of dengue type 2, complexed with a proteinaceous inhibitor.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we were successful in the crystallization of a dengue virus serine protease in complex with a natural inhibitor, mung bean Bowman-Birk type inhibitor, and that we collected MAD data to 2.8 A resolution on the complex.
we were able to crystallize the complex, we collected MAD data, we were able to determine the anomalous signal, and we were able to measure the data.
we have crystallized and characterized a complex of the essential dENGUE VIRUS NS3 SERINE PROTEASE WITH AN INHIBITOR OF INTEREST.
The main takeaway from our work is that
MAD data are not always easy to collect and that the use of MAD methods requires careful consideration of the experimental parameters, including crystal size, X-ray energy, wavelength and flux.
the use of MAD methods for structure determination can provide a valuable tool for structure determination when other methods fail.
it is possible to obtain useful MAD data from a single derivative of a crystal that was grown under conditions that were not optimized for anomalous scattering.
